hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.swift) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; n=$(basename "$f"); grep -qF "/* $n in Sources */" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/PureSudoku.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj" || jq -n --arg n "$n" '{systemMessage: ("pbxproj check: " + $n + " is not in a Sources build phase"), hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: ($n + " is not compiled: it has no \"in Sources\" entry in PureSudoku.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj. Add PBXFileReference, PBXBuildFile, group child, and PBXSourcesBuildPhase entries (see CLAUDE.md).")}}'
